summary: Cohort quarantine revocation causes tenant model-pin mismatch and silent fallback
description:
Issue summary: During a targeted canary push to ~10% of traffic for rwinf-redwood-2.1-xl, a cohort quarantine/revocation step executed by the orchestrator revoked cohort membership before cohort pin metadata was fully committed to the edge caches. Impact: Affected tenant (BeaconForms Inc) experienced silent fallback to legacy model variant (open-llama-30b-q4_0) for ~27 minutes. Requests returned mixed outputs without error codes; billing reflected calls to the legacy variant which impacted SLAs and evaluation continuity.

Expected: cohort quarantine/revocation should either wait until edge pin commits are durable or trigger an explicit rollback with visible 4xx/5xx signals so customers can detect fallback.

Observed behavior: No 5xx errors; user requests were accepted and processed by legacy variant. Route metadata at control-plane showed 'pin: rwinf-redwood-2.1-xl' but edge cookie and cohort membership expired earlier, producing token-to-route divergence.
impact: Customer-facing generation quality regression and billing discrepancy for BeaconForms flows. Sessions tied to the tenant lost model affinity and some prompts returned significantly different output. Customer reported interrupted QA and a production regression alert. Estimated affected traffic: 2.3k requests, duration ~27 minutes.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure a staged canary roll for model rwinf-redwood-2.1-xl at 10% traffic for tenant beacon-forms (dedicated).
2) Schedule a quarantined cohort eviction in orchestrator with prewarm enabled.
3) Force a short orchestrator control-plane snapshot merge (simulate noisy coordinator) while edge cache TTLs are being rotated.
4) Observe tenant session tokens and edge cookie namespaces for mismatch and confirm requests being routed to legacy variant despite control-plane pin metadata.

2026-03-10T14:12:04Z edge-router.WARN cookie: namespace rotation detected, cookie_domain=beacon-forms.local ttl_old=120s ttl_new=30s
2026-03-10T14:12:06Z orchestrator.ERROR commit: cohort membership write incomplete: write_ack_timeout
2026-03-10T14:39:10Z control-plane.INFO reconcile: pin metadata reconciled to rwinf-redwood-2.1-xl for tenant beacon-forms (post-fix)
Example request trace: req=abcd1234 -> edge chose variant=open-llama-30b-q4_0, control-plane_pin=rwinf-redwood-2.1-xl
comments: Support (Aisha): Customer opened with QA screenshots showing degraded outputs at 14:14 UTC. Asked SRE to escalate for potential pin mismatch.
SRE (Tomas): Initial look shows orchestrator revoked cohort before edge ack. Opening controller snapshot logs and asking for edge-router traces; tagging @platform-team.
Customer (BeaconForms): Provided examples and said billing shows calls counted to legacy variant. Requesting immediate mitigation and clarification on root cause.

SRE (Tomas): Applied mitigation at 14:42 UTC - forced explicit tenant pin flush and disabled automatic cohort revocation for that tenant. Confirmed routes back to intended model at 14:46 UTC. Noted potential race in commit window handling.
Support (Aisha): Notified customer of temporary mitigation and shared steps to reproduce for internal triage. Customer accepted temporary workaround and requested postmortem.
PM (Elaine Park): Marking follow up to capture rollout guardrails; asked to include canary prewarm invariants in release checklist.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Quarantine flow triggers a cohort membership revocation before the commit window fully persists pins to the distributed edge caches; commit ack was lost due to a short write timeout (write_ack_timeout).

Hypothesis 2: Edge cookie namespace rotation TTL change (120s -> 30s) caused cookie-based affinity tokens to expire earlier than control-plane metadata, creating a window where control-plane believed tenant pinned but edge selected fallback routing.

Evidence: Orchestrator error logs show write_ack_timeout at 14:12:06Z. Edge router warnings show cookie TTL rotation at 14:12:04Z. Reconciliation occurred at 14:39:10Z after a control-plane snapshot merge. Traces show mismatched variant selection across components.
Attempted reproductions in staging: Reproduced mismatch when forcing snapshot merges and edge TTL shrink; could not reproduce when prewarm handshake is blocked until edge ack.
resolution_summary: Mitigations performed: 1) Forced tenant-specific pin flush and explicit cache invalidation at edge to restore affinity (14:42-14:46 UTC). 2) Temporarily disabled automatic cohort revocation for the tenant pipeline to prevent recurrence during ongoing canary. 3) Rolled back the cookie namespace TTL change for production edge fleet while root cause analysis continued. Outcome: Traffic returned to rwinf-redwood-2.1-xl; customer confirmed recovery and asks for a postmortem and billing reconciliation.
follow_up_tasks: T1: Add commit-window ack gating so orchestrator will not revoke cohort membership until edge-router acks persisted pin (owner: orchestrator-team, ETA: 2026-03-19).
T2: Implement telemetry alert for pin/edge-cookie divergence with automatic rollback (owner: edge-team, ETA: 2026-03-22).
T3: Postmortem documenting timeline, impact, and billing reconciliation plan (owner: SRE/Support, ETA: 2026-03-16).
T4: Backfill end-to-end integration test in staging to simulate fast cookie TTL rotation during canary commit (owner: qa, ETA: 2026-03-24).
resolution: Workaround applied; awaiting code changes and postmortem
notes_for_billing: Customer billed for model open-llama-30b-q4_0 for requests between 2026-03-10T14:12:00Z and 2026-03-10T14:39:10Z. Finance should prepare a credit for BeaconForms Inc for estimated 2.3k affected requests. Contact billing@redwood.ai with SUP-286714 reference.
